content_metadata.description: An analysis of Patriots fans' reactions to the team's season opener loss and the growing criticism of Tom Brady, with a focus on fan tweets calling for his replacement by Jimmy Garoppolo. The video also highlights the unexpected success of Kansas City Chiefs' Kareem Hunt in his NFL debut.
